article_title: Mother and daughter die after suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: A mother and daughter died in British Columbia in a suspected bear attack, and officers are investigating what happened.
Canada has announced that every grizzly bear will be moved out of British Columbia.
A family successfully rescued two hikers from a bear sanctuary.
Officials have confirmed that several bears attacked a school on 1 November.
tasks.correct_answer: A mother and daughter died in British Columbia in a suspected bear attack, and officers are investigating what happened.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת במותן של אם ובתה בבריטיש קולומביה, בחשד למעורבות דוב ובחקירה שעדיין נמשכת.

tasks.prompt: When were Jennifer Balcarras and Selah Reed reported missing?
options: After a school trip in October
On 1 November, when they did not return from a short afternoon walk
In 2017, after a hunting ban
After moving away from Bella Coola
tasks.correct_answer: On 1 November, when they did not return from a short afternoon walk
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השתיים דווחו כנעדרות ב־1 בנובמבר לאחר שלא חזרו מטיול אחר צהריים קצר.

tasks.prompt: What does “track down” mean when officers are trying to track down bears?
options: Count every bear in Canada
Move a trail to another area
Find or locate after searching
Write a report about wildlife
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי track down פירושו לאתר או למצוא לאחר חיפוש.

tasks.prompt: What did the conservation service say about the scene?
options: It proved that two bears were involved.
It showed that the women had left the province.
It contained no signs of wildlife.
Evidence suggested an animal may have been involved.
tasks.correct_answer: Evidence suggested an animal may have been involved.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השירות אמר שהראיות בזירה הצביעו על אפשרות שמעורבת הייתה חיה, אך החקירה טרם קבעה זאת בוודאות.

tasks.prompt: How many grizzly bears are estimated to live in British Columbia?
options: Between 10,000 and 13,000
Fewer than 100
Exactly 2,017
More than one million
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי משרד הסביבה של הפרובינציה, ההערכה היא שבבריטיש קולומביה חיים בין 10,000 ל־13,000 דובי גריזלי.

tasks.prompt: What does the expression “two peas in a pod” suggest about the mother and daughter?
options: They often argued about hiking.
They lived in different provinces.
They were very close and similar.
They worked as conservation officers.
tasks.correct_answer: They were very close and similar.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר אנשים קרובים מאוד ודומים זה לזה; בני המשפחה סיפרו שהאם והבת הסתדרו היטב וחלקו תחביבים.

tasks.prompt: Describe the search timeline for the two women.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את הדיווח על ההיעדרות ואת מועד מציאת כל אחת מהנשים.
expected_points: They were reported missing on 1 November after failing to return from a short walk.
Jennifer Balcarras' remains were found on Monday.
Selah Reed's remains were found on Tuesday.
Conservation officers and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police took part in the searches.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article repeatedly use cautious words such as “suspected”, “may” and “potentially”?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהחקירה טרם הושלמה ולהבחין בין ראיות לבין מסקנה מאושרת.
expected_points: Evidence suggested an animal may have been involved, but officials had not completed the investigation.
Officers were still trying to find any bears involved.
It was not yet clear whether one bear or more than one bear might have been involved.
The cautious wording avoids presenting an unconfirmed explanation as fact.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the incident and the official response in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מקום האירוע, הנעדרות, החיפוש והמשך החקירה בלי להוסיף פרטים שלא אושרו.
expected_points: Jennifer Balcarras and her daughter Selah Reed disappeared after a short walk near Bella Coola, British Columbia.
Their remains were found on successive days during a search by conservation officers and police.
Evidence suggested an animal may have been involved, and officers were attempting to locate any bears.
Officials said any captured bear would be assessed under provincial public-safety guidelines.

tasks.prompt: Write a short, sensitive news update about the investigation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב דיווח מכבד ומדויק, להימנע מסנסציוניות ולהבהיר מה ידוע ומה עדיין אינו ידוע.
expected_points: Identify the victims and the Bella Coola location accurately.
State that an animal's involvement is suspected rather than confirmed.
Mention that conservation officers are investigating and searching for bears.
Avoid graphic detail and unsupported claims.
